name: Άγιος Θεολόγος
evidence: Disambiguated from the Kos namesake via Patmos-specific sources: this is the beach on the north side of Skala harbour (matches lat 37.326). patmosislandgreece.com states explicitly: 'There are no sun beds on the beach, but there are plenty of Tamarisk trees' and 'Two Cafes have their chairs with umbrellas for shade right next to the shore'. Multiple guides call it 'not organized'. Cafes/tavernas adjacent but no sunbed/umbrella rental operation and no beach bar.

name: Σάψιλα
evidence: Greeka page for the specific Sapsila beach between Skala and Grikos, Patmos (matches coords): 'The beach is not organized, so there are no sunbeds or umbrellas available here.' Restaurants exist in the settlement nearby but not on the beach.

name: Παραλία Αλυκή
evidence: Coordinate disambiguation corrected round1: lat 36.108/lng 27.730 is the WEST coast below Monolithos, Rhodes — matching Greeka's 'Just below the village of Monolithos, about 75 km southwest of Rhodes Town'. Greeka: 'Alyki Beach is unorganized, however you will find a handful of sunbeds available for rent'; Tripadvisor reviews confirm 'a dozen umbrellas with sunbeds for rent' run by a named manager. 'No shops or canteens in the area' — sunbed/umbrella rental yes, no bar/canteen. Minimal operation (a dozen sets).

name: Παραλία Γαλούνι
evidence: Only evidence remains municipal: the Rhodes 2026 aigialos-concession map (dimokratiki.gr) lists a 150 τ.μ. umbrella-concession plot with toponym 'ΓΑΛΟΥΝΙ' in the Νότια Ρόδος section — an auctioned plot, not proof an operator actually runs sunbeds there. No Tripadvisor page, no guide coverage, no taverna/bar evidence for this remote stretch. Bias to under-claim.

name: Σύμη Γυάλα
evidence: Dedicated Tripadvisor attraction 'Giala beach bar' listed under Emporios (Nimborio), Symi — same locality as the coords (36.621/27.821, adjacent to Nimborio). Accommodation pages in Nimborio describe Gyala as 'a lovely beach which also has a summer bar under the tamarisk trees', a 200 m walk from Nimborio. Beach bar confirmed at this specific beach; no explicit sunbed evidence, so sunbeds left null.

name: Μαράθι
evidence: Disambiguated from Marathi/Crete (all sunbed hits belonged to the Cretan beach). For the islet near Arki: multiple Greek sources confirm 'two taverns at the two edges of the beach' (Pantelis since 1978, plus Michalis/Marathi) on the single sandy harbour bay — but neither marathi-island.gr nor any guide explicitly mentions sunbeds/umbrellas on the beach (the only 'sun beds' quote is a private terrace), and one source describes the wider islets as service-free. Tavernas on-beach yes; organized sunbed/bar operation unproven.

name: Mirtia Strand
evidence: Coordinates (38.627, 20.935) fall on the NW coast of Kalamos island (not the Paleros mainland or Lake Trichonida village): this is the long Myrtia beach of Kalamos, ~1.5km from Kalamos port. Tripadvisor describes it as unspoiled, no infrastructure, only nature; a reviewer notes nothing nearby, a free-camping spot reached by boat/steep path.

name: Μυρτιά
evidence: Adjacent segment of the same ~1.3km Myrtia beach on Kalamos island (38.630, 20.940). Same sources: natural beach with no facilities, no sunbeds, boat/path access only. Disambiguated from Lake Trichonida Myrtia and Paleros mainland by coordinates landing on Kalamos.

name: Παραθάλασσο
evidence: Travelgo article on Monastiraki Fokidas: 'η οργανωμένη παραλία Παραθάλασσο, 500μ δυτικά του χωριού... ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες πάνω σε μια μακρόστενη λωρίδα γης με ψιλό βότσαλο' (the 'blue lagoon' beach). Name is unique on this Corinthian-gulf coast so identity is solid; caveat: our pin (21.933) sits ~3-4km west of Monastiraki (nearer Sergoula), so pin placement may be off even though the amenity verdict is well-sourced.

name: Παραλία Αγ. Σπυρίδωνα Λουτρακίου
evidence: Disambiguated to Loutraki of Katouna on the Amvrakikos (sinidisi article confirms the Agios Spyridonas plane-tree/icon in this settlement, feast Aug 11). The article covers the settlement's beaches but names no facilities beyond one seasonal canteen at the main beach; nothing specific found for the Ag. Spyridonas stretch itself — no source claims sunbeds or a bar here, but no explicit 'μη οργανωμένη' either.

name: Παραλία Διόνι
evidence: Dioni at Katochi/Acheloos mouth (Oiniades) — agriniopress cites 'the beach bar Navagio' as a main draw, and 'Mammos Beach Bar Dioni Katochi' operates there since 2022 (its own Facebook page). Beach bar confirmed at this exact locality; no explicit sunbed evidence (local article mentions only sandy/shallow), so sunbeds left null.

name: Παραλία Λουτρακίου
evidence: Loutraki of Katouna, Amvrakikos gulf (sinidisi local article, correct settlement per Wikipedia 'Λουτράκι Αιτωλοακαρνανίας'): only amenity is 'μια καντίνα «ο Μόλος» από ιδιώτη τους καλοκαιρινούς μήνες'; the old café/taverna no longer operate. No sunbeds/umbrellas/beach bar mentioned anywhere; the beachsearcher listing claiming umbrellas+bars is auto-generated and discounted.

name: Παραλία Πατητηρίου
evidence: Greeka's dedicated Patitiri-beach page (pebble beach 200m from Alonissos port — matches the port coords): 'does not offer sunbeds or umbrellas, so visitors are advised to bring towels'; restaurants/cafes are behind the beach in town, not beach facilities. Multiple guides list Rousoum Gialos as the nearest organized beach.

name: Πλάκες
evidence: Rock-slab spot reached on foot from the Alonissos camping just north of Patitiri (matches coords): 'There are no facilities at Plakes (no taverna, no sunbeds, no umbrellas)… carry water and an umbrella'; Tripadvisor reviews describe a secluded hidden beach accessible only on foot.

name: Τζώρτζη
evidence: Greeka + The Wom Travel on the SE-Alonissos bay 6km from Patitiri (matches coords): 'The beach is unorganized, lacking sunbeds and umbrellas… advisable to bring a parasol.' There IS a traditional taverna behind the shore (food/restrooms), but no sunbeds and no beach bar.

name: Παραλία Κάστρου
evidence: Round-1 conflict resolved: both Greeka ('does not boast amenities such as sunbeds or parasols… bring towels') and travel.gr's dedicated Kastro article ('quite unorganised, so if you're looking for shade under an umbrella, you should bring your own') agree there are NO rental sunbeds/umbrellas; there is only the seasonal 'Kastro Beach' canteen selling coffee/refreshments/sandwiches. The 'canteen offers sunbeds' claim found no support in any specific source.

name: Αγιά Θυμιά
evidence: Locality pinned: Pagasitic-gulf side near Lefokastro, South Pelion (Mapcarta/BeachAtlas/hotels.com all place Agia Thymia at Lefokastro, consistent with lat 39.2565 lng 23.1758). Beach guides describe it as 'a spacious pebbly cove that is wild, with no amenities'; only a canteen/camper van selling coffee, water, sweets. No sunbeds/umbrellas/bar anywhere.

name: Βρωμονέρι
evidence: Disambiguated to the Pelion Vromoneri near Katigiorgis (Aegean side, Skiathos view — Tripadvisor Katigiorgis listing + walking-trail pages match coords; not Messinia). Sources conflict: hiking pages describe a taverna-cafe a few dozen metres from the beach with showers, and ilovepelion states 'Η παραλία της είναι οργανωμένη, όπου θα βρείτε εστιατόριο και ξενοδοχείο' — but NO source explicitly mentions sunbeds/umbrellas, and Tripadvisor/trail write-ups read as a quiet sandy cove. No explicit sunbed/bar evidence → not promotable to ORGANIZED.

name: Μικρό
evidence: Greek Wikipedia on Μικρό Μαγνησίας (the Aegean-side beach settlement 8km from Lafkos, next to Platanias — matches coords, distinct from Platanias itself): 'Η παραλία-οικισμός διαθέτει ταβέρνες, καφέ-bar με ενοικιαζόμενες ξαπλώστρες, ξενοδοχεία και ενοικιαζόμενα δωμάτια' — explicit rented sunbeds + café-bars AT Mikro, corroborated by aroundpelion.com.

name: Μορτίτσα
evidence: No source documents any facilities at Mortitsa itself; round-1 describes it as a solitary beach for people who want to be alone. The adjacent, much better-known Mourtias (same SE Pelion stretch matching the pin) is explicitly 'εντελώς ανοργάνωτη — φέρτε δική σας ομπρέλα' (mythessaly.gr) and Greeka states 'no tourist facilities, like umbrellas, sun beds or taverns' for the Mourtia coast. No organized claim exists anywhere; conservative verdict unorganized.

name: Νταμούχαρη
evidence: Guides for the Mamma Mia harbor at Mouresi (matches pin 39.4036,23.1813) agree the beach itself has no sunbeds/umbrellas: 'Unlike larger tourist beaches, Damouchari offers no sunbeds or umbrellas; trees provide natural shade' (greecetravelsecrets/hellenicseason). Tavernas exist by the harbor and one taverna rents lounging chairs under its own olive trees next to the restaurant — not on the beach — so no organized/beach-bar claim on the beach itself.

name: Πάλτση
evidence: Pelioxenia's dedicated Paltsi page (SE Pelion 13km from Argalasti, matches pin): 'During July and August, you'll find sunbeds and parasols available, along with open tavernas serving fresh seafood' — explicit seasonal sunbeds plus two tavernas behind the beach. No beach bar documented; organized = seasonal sunbeds + tavernas only.

name: Παραλία Ανάληψης
evidence: Disambiguated to the Pouri/Zagora Analipsi (pin 39.4688,23.1119, 3.5km from Pouri, north of Chorefto — not the Afissos one). ilovepelion: 'Χωρίς τουριστικές υποδομές και περαιτέρω αξιοποιήσεις, η Ανάληψη δεν είναι παρά ένα ησυχαστήριο' — explicit no tourist infrastructure. The taverna Plymari sits mid-beach but there is no sunbed/umbrella/bar service.

name: Ραζή
evidence: The only documented Razi beach in Pelion is the Pagasitic-side one 'μετά την Άφησσο' near Lefokastro; ilovepelion states explicitly 'εφόσον δεν διαθέτει οργάνωση' — bring your own umbrella and water, shade from tamarisks. Note: our pin (39.2599,23.1733) sits ~7km south of Lefokastro, but no second Razi beach exists in sources; either way no organized claim is supported.

name: Αγία Παρασκευή (Αγιά)
evidence: Pin 39.7235,22.752 lies between Paliouria and Koutsoupia on the Agia coast, but the Dimos Agias official beach list (Agiokampos, Sotiritsa, Velika, Mouka, Koutsoupia, Palouria, Kokkinonero, Platia Ammos, Stomio…) contains no Agia Paraskevi beach, and all searches only surface unrelated Agia Paraskevi beaches (Thesprotia, Chalkidiki, Karystos, Skiathos, Crete). No evidence tied to this cove either way.

name: Παραλία Στρίντζος
evidence: Larissanet feature on Strintzos–Alexandrini (Pineios delta, ~5km from Stomio, matches pin): Strintzos attracts visitors 'who want their peace and quiet' incl. van campers, in the Natura delta with huts; the only service mentioned — 'Για υπηρεσίες υπάρχει beach bar' — is credited to the adjacent Alexandrini beach, not Strintzos itself. No sunbed/umbrella/bar evidence for Strintzos proper.
